The '''Bronze Crescent''' was an award given to members of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. [[Havoc Squad]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] received a Bronze Crescent for stopping [[Harron Tavus]] and his defectors.
